content.raw:
Tradenest Naturals is a manufacturer and exporter of dehydrated, spray dried, spice and botanical powders based in Surat, India. We supply Canadian food manufacturers, brands, importers and distributors with consistent bulk ingredients, from a 5 Kg trial order to full container loads.

Request a quote: export@tradenestnaturals.com | WhatsApp +91 92651 28276

Why Canada buyers source from Tradenest Naturals

  • Low MOQ of 5 Kg: test a product with your team before committing to volume.
  • 80+ ingredients from one supplier: consolidate fruit, vegetable, spice and herbal powders in one shipment.
  • Dehydrated and spray dried options: choose the process, mesh size and grade that suits your application.
  • Private label and custom packing: bulk bags or retail-ready pouches and jars.
  • FSSAI licensed and IEC registered, with export documentation support for every shipment.
  • Responsive export desk: We answer emails and WhatsApp messages quickly and can schedule calls in Canadian morning or evening hours.

Ingredient ranges we supply to Canada

  • Spray dried fruit powders: mango, pineapple, strawberry, blueberry, lemon juice and more for beverages, dairy, bakery and smoothie mixes.
  • Spray dried vegetable powders: beetroot, carrot, garlic, cabbage and tomato for soups, sauces, seasonings and colour.
  • Dehydrated vegetable powders & flakes: onion, potato, tomato, spinach and beetroot powders and flakes for ready meals and snack seasonings.
  • Dehydrated herbs & leaves: basil, oregano, rosemary, thyme, parsley, mint and bay leaves for seasoning blends.
  • Spices & masala powders: turmeric, red chilli, coriander, black pepper and chai masala.
  • Herbal & botanical powders: ashwagandha, moringa, tulsi, neem, shatavari, amla and other Indian botanicals.
  • Superfood & green powders: moringa, wheatgrass, barley grass and alfalfa.

See the full product catalog for specifications such as mesh size, moisture and shelf life.

Popular products with Canada buyers

  • Moringa Leaf Powder
  • Turmeric Powder
  • Ashwagandha Powder
  • Dehydrated Onion Powder
  • Dehydrated Potato Powder
  • Spray Dried Beetroot Powder
  • Spray Dried Strawberry Powder
  • Chai Masala Powder

Who we work with in Canada

  • Food and snack manufacturers
  • Seasoning and spice blenders
  • Natural health and wellness brands
  • Private label and online brands
  • South Asian grocery importers
  • Distributors and ingredient traders

Shipping and documents

We ship by sea freight to Canadian ports such as Vancouver, Montreal and Halifax, and by air or courier for samples and small orders. Incoterms such as FOB or CIF can be quoted on request.

Every order ships with a commercial invoice, packing list and product specification sheet, and we support other export documents as your shipment requires. For shipments to Canada, the Canadian importer usually holds the import licence and handles clearance with the CFIA and CBSA. Tell us what your compliance team needs and we will confirm which documents we can provide for your order before you commit.

How ordering works

  1. Send your requirement: product, quantity, grade or mesh, packing and destination.
  2. Get a quote and samples: we confirm price, lead time and specifications.
  3. Confirm the order: we process, pack and label to your requirement.
  4. Dispatch: we arrange shipment and share documents and tracking.

Frequently asked questions

What is your minimum order quantity for Canada?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg per product, so you can trial an ingredient before ordering in bulk. Larger volumes are quoted per order.

Can I get samples before ordering?

Yes. Samples are available on request and are usually sent by courier.

Do you offer private label packing?

Yes. We supply bulk bags and can pack in smaller private label pouches and jars for your brand.

Which licences do you hold?

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and holds an Import Export Code (IEC) from the Government of India. We also provide export documentation support.

How do I get a price?

Send the product, quantity, mesh or grade, packing and destination port to export@tradenestnaturals.com or WhatsApp +91 92651 28276. We reply with a quote, usually within one business day.

Get a quote for Canada

Email export@tradenestnaturals.com, message us on WhatsApp at +91 92651 28276, or use our contact page. Tradenest Naturals, Ashirwad Embro Park-1, Plot No. 1, 4th Floor, Saniya Hemad, Surat, Gujarat 395006, India.

Natural Ingredients from India, Built for Global Food Brands

Tradenest Naturals is a manufacturer and exporter of natural food ingredients based in Surat, Gujarat, India. We make dehydrated vegetable powders and flakes, spray dried fruit and vegetable powders, herbal and Ayurvedic botanical powders, culinary herbs, spices and seasoning powders. Our customers are food manufacturers, nutraceutical and cosmetic brands, distributors and importers who need a consistent ingredient, clear specifications and dependable export support. We are an FSSAI-licensed food business and an IEC-registered exporter, and we ship worldwide from India.

What We Make

Our range is organised into nine product categories. Each product page lists the typical specification, and a full specification sheet is shared with every quotation.

  • Dehydrated Herbs and Leaves: culinary herbs such as basil, oregano, rosemary, thyme, parsley, bay leaves and kasuri methi.
  • Dehydrated Onion Products: onion powder, chopped onion and onion granules for seasonings, soups and ready meals.
  • Dehydrated Vegetable Powders and Flakes: tomato, potato, beetroot, spinach and other vegetables in powder and flake form.
  • Herbal and Ayurvedic Powders: botanicals such as ashwagandha, moringa, neem, shatavari and amla, traditionally used in herbal formulations.
  • Seasoning and Specialty Powders: ingredients for snack seasonings, sauces and savoury blends.
  • Spices and Masala Powders: turmeric, red chilli, coriander, black pepper and blended masalas.
  • Spray Dried Fruit Powders: mango, pineapple, strawberry, berry and other fruit powders for beverages and dry mixes.
  • Spray Dried Vegetable Powders: beetroot, carrot, garlic and other vegetables processed by spray drying.
  • Superfood and Green Powders: wheat grass, barley grass, alfalfa and other green leaf powders.

We also make custom seasoning blends to your recipe or target flavour for snack, sauce, ready meal and foodservice brands, and food premixes are being added to our range. If you need an ingredient you do not see listed, ask us.

How We Work

Every product follows the same basic route from raw material to packed shipment. Each step is planned around the specification agreed with the buyer.

Sourcing

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers and suppliers. We check incoming material for appearance, aroma and foreign matter before it goes into production.

Cleaning and Sorting

Material is cleaned and sorted to remove stems, stones, dust and damaged pieces.

Drying and Spray Drying

Vegetables, herbs and leaves are dried under controlled conditions. Fruit and selected vegetable products are made by spray drying, which turns a liquid into a fine, free-flowing powder.

Steam Sterilization

Where the product and the buyer's specification call for it, material is treated by steam sterilization to reduce microbial load.

Milling and Sieving

Dried material is milled and sieved to the required mesh size. Custom specifications for mesh size and moisture can be discussed on request.

Inspection and Packing

Each batch is inspected against the agreed specification before it is packed. Products are packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging, with the batch number and dates on every pack. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Who We Serve

  • Food and snack manufacturers who need seasonings, vegetable powders and spices
  • Beverage and dry mix brands using spray dried fruit and vegetable powders
  • Nutraceutical and supplement brands buying herbal and green powders
  • Cosmetic and personal care brands using botanical powders
  • Importers, distributors and repackers supplying their local markets
  • New brands that want to trial an ingredient before scaling up

Export Support

We work with buyers in the USA, UK, Canada, Europe, the Middle East and Australia. See our export markets page for more detail.

  • Low MOQ from 5 Kg per product, so you can test the market before ordering larger volumes
  • Export documentation support for every shipment, planned with you at the quotation stage
  • Samples on request so your QA team can test before a bulk order
  • OEM & private label packing for your brand
  • Packaging options from small private label packs and 5 to 10 kg bags up to 25 kg bags and HDPE containers
  • A product specification sheet with every quotation

Licences and Registrations

  • FSSAI licensed food business
  • IEC (Importer Exporter Code) registered exporter

Contact Our Export Desk

Share your product, quantity, specification and destination country, and we will come back with a quotation and specification sheet.

  • WhatsApp: +91 92651 28276
